The idea that scientists backed "global cooling" in the 70s is a myth, scientists never backed that. Temperatures dropped due to increased emissions of aerosols that have the reverse effect of greenhouse gases. Volcanic activity can have the same effect; the 1991 eruption of Mt. Pinatubo caused a global temperature drop of about 0.5C, but this only lasted a couple of years.

Global warming is not some new concept, the theory that increased greenhouse gases will cause an increase in the greenhouse effect is over 100 years old.
